name: network-service-decoy
description: Emulates SNMP (v1/v2c/v3) and log-only DNS (UDP and TCP) with strict anti-amplification guards to detect MIB enumeration, community-string guessing, SNMP writes and DNS reconnaissance or zone transfers.
author: Doppel
documentation: Runs as UID 0 with every capability dropped except NET_BIND_SERVICE (needed for SNMP UDP port 161 and DNS port 53 in host networking; Docker grants added capabilities only to root). Read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges. SNMP community strings are reported as an HMAC with the node's capture key by default (TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE=hash). SNMP v1/v2c answers only GetRequest and GetNextRequest for the system group when TS_SNMP_COMMUNITY is set and matches in constant time; all other communities stay silent. SNMP v3 answers only unknown-engine-ID discovery Report PDUs. DNS never resolves, recurses or forwards and replies REFUSED echoing only the question. Strict anti-amplification guards enforce a per-source reply rate limit, DNS reply size <= request size, and SNMP reply size <= request size + 64 bytes. Per-protocol enabled_key flags ensure disabled protocols do not hold ports.

config.name: TS_ENABLE_SNMP
config.description: Enable the SNMP (v1/v2c/v3) UDP decoy listener

config.name: TS_SNMP_PORT
config.description: UDP port for the SNMP decoy

config.name: TS_SNMP_COMMUNITY
config.description: Optional v1/v2c community string that unlocks read-only system-group replies (empty = stay silent to all v1/v2c queries)

config.name: TS_ENABLE_DNS
config.description: Enable the log-only DNS UDP decoy listener

config.name: TS_ENABLE_DNS_TCP
config.description: Enable the log-only DNS TCP decoy listener (detects AXFR/IXFR zone transfer attempts)

config.name: TS_DNS_PORT
config.description: Port for the log-only DNS decoy (UDP and/or TCP)

config.name: TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE
config.description: hash: HMAC with the node capture key; plain: clear text; none: not captured

config.name: TS_REPLY_RATE_PER_SEC
config.description: Maximum UDP replies per second per source IP (anti-amplification guard)

config.name: TS_MAX_CONNS
config.description: Concurrent TCP DNS connections across all sources

config.name: TS_MAX_PER_SOURCE
config.description: Concurrent TCP DNS connections per source IP

config.name: TS_EVENT_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Event rate-limit window in seconds per source (0 = report every query)

triggers.name: snmp_query
triggers.description: SNMP v1/v2c/v3 request received (SetRequest is elevated to high severity)

triggers.name: dns_query
triggers.description: DNS query received (AXFR/IXFR over TCP is elevated to high severity)
